interview.name: Bo
interview.answer: The repair drive is still on, but the notes don’t say when or where it is being held.

reflections: Bo defers to Opal and Rosa for details before committing.
Opal is the one verifying information and setting a cautious tone.
Rosa is responsive and provides the needed repair-drive details.
Bo is careful about not guessing and waits for confirmed details before acting.
Rosa and Hana both take a coordinating role by promising to send the repair drive details and follow up on what is still needed.
The group is aligned around verification and sharing the latest repair drive information before committing to next steps.
Bo is consistently available to help coordinate and review the repair drive details.
Hana and Jules are still gathering or passing along the final list, so the group is waiting on a clear inventory before acting.
Tess is providing the most concrete logistical update, including location and timing, which helps everyone align on the pickup plan.
Bo is coordinating by asking for repair drive details, location, and status before committing.
Tess and Mara appear to be organizing the repair drive logistics and updates for the group.
Opal is helping refine the final location details, while Bo prefers concise confirmations unless something changes.
Bo wants the repair drive details kept brief and actionable; he repeatedly asks to skim the key bits rather than receive full updates.
Bo is comfortable with the event as scheduled and no longer needs location confirmation unless plans change.
The organizers are coordinating logistics and sharing remaining fixes, with the repair drive still active and practical help being offered.
